contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (5,889, written with a thousands comma and NO cents) on the p2 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $5,889' AND its printed 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages) $5,889', and is re-stated at summary lines 4 and 5
contributions.detail: The NINE monetary rows on p3 sum to 1000.00 + 500.00 + 3000.00 + 515.00 + 100.00 + 100.00 + 500.00 + 75.00 + 99.00 = 5,889.00 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal = its printed Total Contributions Received = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 5,889 (first report of the cycle) and is NOT summed as an increment. TWO THINGS THE LADDER DECIDES, not the wording. (1) BOTH OF THE FILER'S OWN LOANS ARE ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION ROWS (ADDENDUM B §B3): he writes 'Ben Stanley (loan to start) $1,000' and 'Ben Stanley (second loan) $3,000' on Schedule A, and summary line 3 'Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period' is a handwritten '0', so there is no beginning-balance slot for them; without the two loans the rows sum to 1,889.00 against a printed 5,889 — they are contributions here, the opposite of the Witney 2010 outcome. (2) IN-KIND IS EXCLUDED, AND THE FILER SAYS SO IN HIS OWN PRINTED FOOTNOTE at the foot of p3: '* In Kind Contributions estimated fair market value not included in contribution total.' The four in-kind entries are published as rows alongside (in_kind=true) but carry NO amount in the Amount column and are not in the sum. The p2 ladder closes: 0 + 5,889 - 5,260.52 = 628.48 = line 7.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE candidate 'Benjamin D. Stanley', party Republican, Office Seeking 'Utah County Attorney', residence Pleasant Grove UT — index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the page face supplies it. legacy_colAB variant, 4 pages: p1 cover ('Seven days preceding the Primary Election', amendment 'No', signed June 17 2014, clerk stamp 'JUN 17 PM 4:36'), p2 SUMMARY PAGE (located by its printed header), p3 SCHEDULE A, p4 SCHEDULE B. FOLIATION COUNTS THE COVER here — summary 'Page 2 of 4', Schedule A 'Page 3 of 4', Schedule B 'Page 4 of 4' — the opposite of the Buhman original in this same chunk and cycle, which foliates its summary 'Page 1 of 4'. Page ordinals locate nothing. MIXED-TEMPLATE SPECIMEN (ADDENDUM D §D2 / E §E2): the cover is the common 2014 blank ('COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES', Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5) while BOTH schedule sheets carry the 2012-era headings — 'Mailing Address & Zip Code' and Schedule B reusing 'Name of Contributor' over the vendor column, with no Purpose column. THE FILER SUPPLIES HIS OWN PURPOSE COLUMN by writing the purpose in parentheses inside the Name cell on every Schedule B row — the bracket-after-payee workaround, used consistently here (never inverted), with each row's address cell agreeing. AN IN-KIND SUB-LEDGER WITH ITS OWN STATED CONVENTION: below the nine monetary rows the filer heads a block 'In Kind Contributions*', numbers four entries 1-4, and prints a footnote at the foot of the page reading '* In Kind Contributions estimated fair market value not included in contribution total.' Three of the four entries carry NO figure; the fourth carries 'FMV approx $4,000' written in the ADDRESS column. All four are published as rows with in_kind=true and blank amounts — an honest floor for the in-kind layer, and the cash side is unaffected and exact. EVERY DATE ON BOTH SCHEDULES OMITS THE YEAR (M/D only, e.g. '3/18'), and one is a RANGE ('April-June'); all are kept verbatim with needs_review=1 and no year is ever filled in from the report date. NOT REDACTED BY THE COUNTY: this filing is not a *_Redacted.pdf and carries no black bars — the candidate's, the donors' and the vendors' street addresses and phone numbers are all visible on the page. None of them is carried into this record, not in a field and not in a note (the 2008-2014 privacy posture of ADDENDUM A §A5). Amount conventions: nine figures across the two schedules are written with a dollar sign and NO cents ($1,000 / $500 / $3,000 / $515 / $100 / $75 / $99 / $78 / $50 / $400) and are recorded as the same value with explicit cents; summary line 3 is a handwritten numeral '0', not a nil mark, so no zero-glyph question arises.
